takes.situation: Inez asks Milena for a loan; Milena prices it and uncovers the secret. Debt first, then the lover.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Milena, lend me tonight's tips. I can't keep up with the Bureau.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: My Bureau card's missing stamps too. What's it worth to you?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: My terrace tables. Anything. Not so loud, that table can hear.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: That one's reading. You've always jumped, Inez. You'd give up that view?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: What view? I watch the clock. Table six wants the bill.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: The clock's behind you. The guard on the Office door isn't.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who told you about Okafor? Who else knows?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You just did. So you're seeing Okafor. What's my silence worth?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If the Office hears, it costs us both. Take the terrace, please.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Bureau loan, behind. Could be cleared. Okafor, her secret. Could be used.

takes.situation: A plate goes cold while Inez stares across the square; Milena attacks first. Lover first, then the debt.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Table four's gone cold, Inez. I'll run it for half the tip.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: No, I have it. Sorry. Did they complain? Who saw?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Only me. Some waitress. You've watched that Office door all shift.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The door? I watch the clock. Shift change is coming.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You jump when the till tube rattles, always have. Is it Okafor?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Hush, please. If the Office hears, it costs us both.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: So you are seeing the guard. What's it worth, me not hearing?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Take my tips. The Bureau gets the rest. I can't keep up.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: I owe the Bureau too. Half your tips, then. Table four, go.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Bureau loan, behind: could clear it. Okafor, Office door: could use that.

takes.situation: A Bureau notice comes up the tube; Inez fears it's from the Office and gives herself away, unprompted.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Tube's brought you another Bureau notice, Inez. Shall I read it?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: The Bureau? Not the Office? You're sure it isn't the Office?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Why would the Office write a waitress? You jump at every tube.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Give it here, please. Table two's waiting. Who else has seen it?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Only me. Overdue. You can't keep up, and neither can I.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Only the Bureau, then? Nobody's said anything? About Okafor and me?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You just did. So it's Okafor on the Office door you're seeing.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Take my terrace tips. If the Office hears, it costs us both.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: I hadn't named a price, Inez. I'll take them. Table two's waiting.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Waitress here. Loan overdue, could be cleared. Okafor on the door, usable.
